parsed_json.sql: SELECT DISTINCT cs.canonical_smiles, sub_mol.pref_name AS substrate_compound_name, parent_mol.pref_name AS parent_compound_name, m.met_conversion, m.pathway_key, m.organism, m.enzyme_name FROM metabolism m INNER JOIN compound_records sub_rec ON m.substrate_record_id = sub_rec.record_id INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary sub_mol ON sub_rec.molregno = sub_mol.molregno INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON sub_mol.molregno = cs.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_records parent_rec ON m.drug_record_id = parent_rec.record_id LEFT JOIN molecule_dictionary parent_mol ON parent_rec.molregno = parent_mol.molregno WHERE m.enzyme_name = 'CYP2D6' ORDER BY cs.canonical_smiles, sub_mol.pref_name, parent_mol.pref_name, m.met_conversion, m.pathway_key, m.organism, m.enzyme_name LIMIT 200
